errors.text_span: Im Diagramm sind sechs verschiedene Linien dargestellt,
errors.evidence: The description states there are six lines, but the chart and legend clearly show seven different materials (Cer, PrNd Mischmetall, Neodym, Terbium, Lanthan, Dysprosium, Praseodym).
The description completely omits the data series for 'Dysprosium (Oxid)', which is represented by the pink line and uses the right y-axis.

errors.text_span: mit Kreis-Markierungen, Neodym (Oxid) als lila Linie mit Quadrat-Markierungen, Lanthan (Oxid) als hellblaue Linie mit Dreieck-Markierungen, Praseodym (Oxid) als hellrosa Linie mit Kreuz-Markierungen, PrNd Mischmetall als dunkelblaue Linie mit Stern-Markierungen und Terbium (Oxid) als graue Linie mit Kreis-Markierungen
errors.evidence: The description invents markers for each line (e.g., 'Kreis-Markierungen', 'Quadrat-Markierungen'). The lines in the chart are solid and do not have any markers.
Praseodym (Oxid) is represented by a light blue line in the chart, not a light pink ('hellrosa') one. The pink line represents Dysprosium (Oxid), which the description omits.
The description incorrectly reads the starting value for Terbium (Oxid) from the left y-axis. The grey line for Terbium starts at approximately 400-500 US-Dollar/kg on the right y-axis.

errors.text_span: wobei Terbium (Oxid) im Jahr 2011 einen Höhepunkt von etwa 420 US-Dollar/kg erreicht
errors.evidence: The peak value for Terbium (Oxid) is read from the wrong (left) y-axis. According to the right y-axis, its peak in 2011 is over 4,000 US-Dollar/kg.
The peak value for Lanthan (Oxid) in 2011 was approximately 250 US-Dollar/kg, not 350 US-Dollar/kg.
The peak value for Praseodym (Oxid) in 2011 was approximately 250 US-Dollar/kg, not 330 US-Dollar/kg.
The value for Terbium (Oxid) in 2013 is incorrectly read from the left y-axis. The value on the correct right y-axis is approximately 800 US-Dollar/kg, not 80.
The price range for Terbium (Oxid) from 2014 onwards is incorrectly read from the left y-axis. The actual range on the right y-axis is approximately 500-800 US-Dollar/kg, a factor of 10 higher.

errors.text_span: PrNd Mischmetall etwa 2.000 US-Dollar/kg, Neodym (Oxid) etwa 1.800 US-Dollar/kg, Lanthan (Oxid) etwa 1.600 US-Dollar/kg, Praseodym (Oxid) etwa 1.500 US-Dollar/kg
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly applies the scale of the right y-axis to metals that are plotted against the left y-axis. For example, PrNd Mischmetall reached about 200 US-Dollar/kg in 2022, not 2,000.
In 2022, the price of Cer (Oxid) was well below 50 US-Dollar/kg, closer to 10 US-Dollar/kg, not 100.

Stating that the lines run 'mostly parallel' is an oversimplification. While they share major trends (a spike in 2011 and a rise after 2020), their relative positions and the magnitudes of their changes vary significantly over time.
